name: khara
brief: Khara, rakshasa lord of the forest outpost. Massive heavy brawler, barrel chest, thick neck, slightly bowed legs. Dark indigo-blue skin. Two large curved bull horns. Wild black hair, a huge upturned moustache, a scowl and fangs. Bronze armour plates on the shoulders and chest, a tiger-skin waist wrap, marigold dhoti, heavy gold anklets. His forward right fist is raised to chest height, closed around nothing, as if gripping a weapon handle. His left hand hangs open. No weapon. Strict right-facing profile, heavy planted stance.
subject: full-body
